Lesson 45 — Triple Net (NNN) leases: a clear, practical breakdown for commercial investors, landlords, building owners, and business owners in Chester County and Montgomery County, Pennsylvania. Under a NNN lease the tenant typically pays base rent plus property taxes, property insurance, and common area maintenance, shifting many operating costs off the owner's monthly ledger. That can create more predictable net income and lower hands-on management, but lease language matters — definitions, cost recovery methods, CAM allocations, caps, and capital expense provisions change owner risk. Always review tenant credit, CAM escalations, roof and structural clauses, and who pays snow removal, landscaping, and HVAC contracts. If you're buying, selling, or leasing locally, use our county-specific NNN checklist and sample clauses. Visit dmsellscre.com/investors to download resources or DM to request a lease review for your property.
